prompt: A React/TypeScript search component fetches /api/search?q=term in useEffect([term]) and older responses sometimes replace newer results. Show a concise typed fix handling response.ok, errors, unmount, and empty terms. Explain why AbortController alone may not prevent a stale already-resolved promise from updating state. State the UI behavior while a request is pending.
review: Unmodified returned TSX fails transpilation: '}' expected. It also fails to invalidate prior request on empty term and never resets mounted.current after StrictMode effect cleanup.
